title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Redcurrant, Grape and Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Redcurrant, Grape & Cherry nicotine salt e-liquid by Rachael Rabbit is a deliciously sweet and sharp fruit blend. The juicy grape and sharp redcurrant on the inhale melts into exquisitely sweet red cherries on the exhale for a deliciously satisfying all-day vape finished to perfection with a streak of cooling ice. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
